name: maturity
description: Evaluate repository maturity for Dockerfiles, npm projects, repository hygiene, and CI workflows, with fixes only on request.

interface.longDescription: Statically evaluate a local checkout for Dockerfile, npm, repository-hygiene, and CI-workflow maturity issues, produce a prioritized findings report with a weighted maturity score, and apply deterministic fixes only when the user asks.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate this repository's Dockerfile, npm, repository-hygiene, and CI-workflow maturity and report findings with a score.
